# zjs

> zjs is a JavaScript / TypeScript engine written in Zig, with a Zig-native
> embedding API and CLI for trusted code. It parses TypeScript directly,
> erases types, and lowers supported runtime syntax; it is not a type checker.

Canonical source: https://github.com/aneryu/zjs

JavaScript semantics follow ECMA-262, validated by the configured test262
profile. QuickJS is a differential reference and performance yardstick.
zjs does not provide Node.js/Deno/browser APIs, hostile-code sandboxing, or
the libquickjs C ABI. It requires Zig 0.16.0; the MIT license retains QuickJS
attribution.

## Use and scope

- [Overview](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/README.md): build, CLI, and embedding example.
- [Embedding cookbook](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/docs/embedding-cookbook.md): host functions, handles, limits, and modules.
- [Public API contract](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/docs/public-api-contract.md): supported Zig API and lifetimes.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md): test262 profile and exclusions.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/LIMITATIONS.md): TypeScript, host APIs, and security boundaries.
